transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Hi Jordan, good to connect again. We reviewed your initial scope from last week. What changes or new considerations came up since our last call?

transcript.speaker: Jordan Rivera
transcript.text: Our board approved the project, but we have a couple of critical updates. First, regarding the location radius search: we decided to expand into Canada next quarter, so the search radius must support both miles and kilometers toggle, not just miles.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Understood. That modifies requirement REQ-001. We will update the geocoding unit selector to support miles and km.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Rivera
transcript.text: Second, to keep our budget within target, we want to drop the verified member badge overlay (REQ-003) for now. Our team can manually verify badges in Phase 2.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Understood. We will remove REQ-003 from the Phase 1 deliverables and deduct the associated design and frontend development hours.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Rivera
transcript.text: Third, we have a new requirement: we need a multi-category CSV import tool so we can bulk-upload 2,000 contractor profiles mapped across multiple parent and sub-categories simultaneously.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Got it. That is a new requirement (REQ-006). Brilliant Directories has a standard CSV member import tool, but mapping multiple categories requires specific column formatting and validation scripts.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Rivera
transcript.text: Also, our sales VP asked if you could just squeeze in a two-way sync with our Salesforce CRM so every customer inquiry auto-generates a Lead object in Salesforce. Can that just be bundled into the current quote?

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Salesforce bidirectional API integration is a major external system integration involving OAuth2 tokens, field mapping, and webhook error handling. That is strictly outside the scope of Phase 1 and cannot be bundled into the current quote. I will document it as an out-of-scope item with a separate change order quote.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Rivera
transcript.text: Fair enough. Glad you caught that before we had misunderstandings. Finally, our board pushed up our product launch: we need everything delivered in 3 weeks instead of 4 weeks.

transcript.speaker: Alex Mercer
transcript.text: Understood. We will update the WBS schedule, recalculate the development sprint allocations, and generate a Scope Change Report highlighting the added, modified, removed, and out-of-scope items for your formal sign-off.
